$comment: Code words the site prints deliberately that are not part of the
@open-e2ee/signal-protocol-sdk surface. Everything else in an inline
<code> span must exist in the SDK, so an invented symbol fails the build.
Add an entry only when the word is genuinely someone else's API, a
platform constant, or a file or table name — never to silence a symbol
that was supposed to be ours. Say whose it is.
